47 passed, including non-ephemeral selection/exclusions, fail-closed boundaries, explicit per-DP port uniqueness/overflow, singleton HashStore selection, and preservation of TCP rendezvous for multi-rank groups.

gpu_evidence: A real one-rank NCCL process group on the assigned AMD gfx950 GPU completed torch.distributed.all_reduce while the advertised TCP port was occupied, demonstrating that the corrected singleton path did not bind TCPStore.
remaining_limitations: The host provides one AMD gfx950 GPU with ROCm, not eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs with CUDA/NCCL.
Qwen3-Embedding weights were unavailable, so the complete eight-GPU serving launch was not run.

Multi-rank groups still use TCPStore. Non-ephemeral allocation prevents the reported OS ephemeral-reuse mechanism but cannot exclude a deliberately competing listener during the close-before-bind interval because PyTorch TCPStore cannot adopt SGLang's reserved socket.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
